compilation.basis: 15000mm/8000mm outer footprint calibrated from dimension-line arrow endpoints (top '15000' chain and left '8000' chain) in 1f_view.png; anchors at outer wall face pixel corners. Interior corridor walls located from gray-wall pixel-color detection (row1/corridor ~y627px, corridor/row2 ~y805px). Partition x-positions (~889px,~1426px) from visible vertical partition lines between offices. Door gaps placed within observed breaks in the gray wall fill near each partition; south entrance and west corridor doors from labeled dimension chains (540/900 south; 3400/1200 west per West_view).

floors.evidence: Second floor plan (2f_view.png); z_floor=3.0m matches North/South/East/West elevation 1F story height (3000mm) placing 2F floor level at 3.0m absolute.

compilation.basis: 15000mm/8000mm outer footprint from dimension-line arrows in 2f_view.png; anchors at outer wall face pixel corners (matches gray wall bbox extents from pixel-color detection). Interior corridor walls at y~604px (top-row/corridor) and y~790px (corridor/bottom-row) from gray-wall pixel detection. Partitions at x~1097px (between the two large meeting rooms, matching visible double-door vestibule) and x~774px, x~1467px (bottom row dividers) from gray-wall region bboxes. Door positions read from zoomed crops of arc/jamb graphics adjacent to each partition. Window spans on north/south walls from labeled dimension chains; west/east single corridor windows from West_view.png/East_view.png 3400-4600mm span, matching corridor depth on this floor too.
